display_text: Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver) ** [[Dexterity| Dexterity +4]][[Dexterity| Dexterity +4]]: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +4 [[Enhancement bonus]] to Dexterity.[[Category: Dexterity +4 items]] → [[Dexterity| Dexterity +6]][[Dexterity| Dexterity +6]]: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 [[Enhancement bonus]] to Dexterity.[[Category: Dexterity +6 items]] ** [[Potency|Potency +48]][[Potency|Potency +48]]: Passive: +48 [[Equipment bonus]] to each [[Spell Power]].[[Category:Potency 48 items]] → [[Potency|Potency +52]][[Potency|Potency +52]]: Passive: +52 [[Equipment bonus]] to each [[Spell Power]].[[Category:Potency 52 items]] ** [[Striding|Striding +20%]][[Striding|Striding +20%]]: This item makes you more fleet of foot, giving you a 20% Enhancement bonus your movement speed.[[Category:Striding +20% items]] → [[Striding|Striding +30%]][[Striding|Striding +30%]]: This item makes you more fleet of foot, giving you a 30% Enhancement bonus your movement speed.[[Category:Striding +30% items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
